verdicts.reason: A has three different left edges: the headline is at about x=22, the blue info box at about x=30 and the black box at about x=50. The black box is also narrower and floats off-centre, so the stack looks staggered and arbitrary, and the gaps between the blocks are uneven. B lines both boxes up as full-width panels on the same margin as the headline and sets the black box's copy at a readable size, so the column reads clean. B's flaws, which A shares: 'COPENHAGEN' runs almost to the right edge, the background photo is cropped to a vague washed-out wall that loses the furniture imagery, and the headline's 5-line stack sits right on top of the blue box.
